description: This file defines the TemplateSampleService class, which provides a static method to retrieve the absolute URL of the company logo by accessing global configuration and theme registry.

classes.name: TemplateSampleService
classes.description: A service class providing utility functions related to PDF templates, specifically for obtaining the company's logo URL.

methods.name: getAbsoluteLogoUrl
methods.description: Returns the absolute URL for the company's logo image by combining the base site URL from configuration with the image URL obtained from the theme registry.
